<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!-- ASSUMPTION (AS-03): standard Backoffice cockpit-ng config; the owner's Backoffice sample has not been supplied.
     Access to CCProductBusinessAttribute is restricted by user rights (group ccbusinessmanagergroup, see essential data).
     Events and feedback are read-only: their attributes are write="false" in items.xml. -->
<config xmlns="http://www.hybris.com/cockpit/config" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
        xmlns:editorArea="http://www.hybris.com/cockpitng/component/editorArea" xmlns:list-view="http://www.hybris.com/cockpitng/component/listView"
        xmlns:simple-search="http://www.hybris.com/cockpitng/config/simplesearch" xmlns:advanced-search="http://www.hybris.com/cockpitng/config/advancedsearch"
        xmlns:wz="http://www.hybris.com/cockpitng/config/wizard-config">

    <context merge-by="type" type="CCConfiguration" component="editor-area">
        <editorArea:editorArea>
            <editorArea:tab name="cc.config.general">
                <editorArea:section name="cc.config.general">
                    <editorArea:attribute qualifier="code"/>
                    <editorArea:attribute qualifier="activePack"/>
                    <editorArea:attribute qualifier="syntheticDataOnly"/>
                    <editorArea:attribute qualifier="enabled"/>
                </editorArea:section>
            </editorArea:tab>
        </editorArea:editorArea>
    </context>
    <context merge-by="type" type="CCConfiguration" component="listview">
        <list-view:list-view>
            <list-view:column qualifier="code"/>
            <list-view:column qualifier="activePack"/>
            <list-view:column qualifier="syntheticDataOnly"/>
            <list-view:column qualifier="enabled"/>
        </list-view:list-view>
    </context>
    <context merge-by="type" type="CCConfiguration" component="simple-search">
        <simple-search:simple-search><simple-search:field name="code"/><simple-search:field name="activePack"/></simple-search:simple-search>
    </context>

    <context merge-by="type" type="CCConfigEntry" component="editor-area">
        <editorArea:editorArea>
            <editorArea:tab name="cc.entry.general">
                <editorArea:section name="cc.entry.general">
                    <editorArea:attribute qualifier="configuration"/>
                    <editorArea:attribute qualifier="entryType"/>
                    <editorArea:attribute qualifier="packCode"/>
                    <editorArea:attribute qualifier="key"/>
                    <editorArea:attribute qualifier="value"/>
                    <editorArea:attribute qualifier="enabled"/>
                    <editorArea:attribute qualifier="sortOrder"/>
                </editorArea:section>
            </editorArea:tab>
        </editorArea:editorArea>
    </context>
    <context merge-by="type" type="CCConfigEntry" component="listview">
        <list-view:list-view>
            <list-view:column qualifier="entryType"/><list-view:column qualifier="packCode"/><list-view:column qualifier="key"/>
            <list-view:column qualifier="value"/><list-view:column qualifier="enabled"/>
        </list-view:list-view>
    </context>
    <context merge-by="type" type="CCConfigEntry" component="simple-search">
        <simple-search:simple-search><simple-search:field name="key"/><simple-search:field name="entryType"/><simple-search:field name="packCode"/></simple-search:simple-search>
    </context>
    <context merge-by="type" type="CCConfigEntry" component="create-wizard">
        <wz:flow id="CCConfigEntryWizard" title="create.title(ctx.TYPE_CODE)">
            <wz:prepare id="prepare"><wz:initialize property="newItem" type="ctx.TYPE_CODE"/></wz:prepare>
            <wz:step id="step1" label="cc.entry.wizard.step1"><wz:content id="content"><wz:property-list root="newItem">
                <wz:property qualifier="configuration"/><wz:property qualifier="entryType"/><wz:property qualifier="packCode"/>
                <wz:property qualifier="key"/><wz:property qualifier="value"/></wz:property-list></wz:content>
                <wz:navigation id="n"><wz:cancel/><wz:done><wz:save property="newItem"/></wz:done></wz:navigation></wz:step>
        </wz:flow>
    </context>

    <context merge-by="type" type="CCInterestEvent" component="listview">
        <list-view:list-view>
            <list-view:column qualifier="eventType"/><list-view:column qualifier="productCode"/><list-view:column qualifier="categoryCode"/>
            <list-view:column qualifier="normalisedToken"/><list-view:column qualifier="packCode"/><list-view:column qualifier="occurredAt"/>
        </list-view:list-view>
    </context>
    <context merge-by="type" type="CCInterestEvent" component="simple-search">
        <simple-search:simple-search><simple-search:field name="eventType"/><simple-search:field name="productCode"/><simple-search:field name="packCode"/></simple-search:simple-search>
    </context>

    <context merge-by="type" type="CCFeedback" component="listview">
        <list-view:list-view>
            <list-view:column qualifier="rating"/><list-view:column qualifier="intent"/><list-view:column qualifier="toolsUsed"/><list-view:column qualifier="createdAt"/>
        </list-view:list-view>
    </context>
    <context merge-by="type" type="CCFeedback" component="simple-search">
        <simple-search:simple-search><simple-search:field name="rating"/><simple-search:field name="intent"/></simple-search:simple-search>
    </context>

    <context merge-by="type" type="CCProductBusinessAttribute" component="editor-area">
        <editorArea:editorArea>
            <editorArea:tab name="cc.business.general">
                <editorArea:section name="cc.business.general">
                    <editorArea:attribute qualifier="product"/><editorArea:attribute qualifier="priority"/>
                    <editorArea:attribute qualifier="margin"/><editorArea:attribute qualifier="packCode"/>
                </editorArea:section>
            </editorArea:tab>
        </editorArea:editorArea>
    </context>
    <context merge-by="type" type="CCProductBusinessAttribute" component="listview">
        <list-view:list-view><list-view:column qualifier="product"/><list-view:column qualifier="priority"/><list-view:column qualifier="packCode"/></list-view:list-view>
    </context>
    <context merge-by="type" type="CCProductBusinessAttribute" component="simple-search">
        <simple-search:simple-search><simple-search:field name="product"/><simple-search:field name="packCode"/></simple-search:simple-search>
    </context>

    <context merge-by="type" type="CCUsageCounter" component="listview">
        <list-view:list-view>
            <list-view:column qualifier="customer"/><list-view:column qualifier="periodKey"/><list-view:column qualifier="messageCount"/><list-view:column qualifier="tokenCount"/>
        </list-view:list-view>
    </context>
    <context merge-by="type" type="CCUsageCounter" component="simple-search">
        <simple-search:simple-search><simple-search:field name="customer"/><simple-search:field name="periodKey"/></simple-search:simple-search>
    </context>
</config>

files.backend/ccocc/resources/ccocc/web/spring:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!-- ASSUMPTION (AS-03): OCC web Spring config; wire per the yocc template of the owner's release and the extension's web root (spike S1).
     Controllers use a package scan as the other OCC controllers do. -->
<beans xmlns="http://www.springframework.org/schema/beans" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
       xmlns:context="http://www.springframework.org/schema/context"
       xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.springframework.org/schema/beans http://www.springframework.org/schema/beans/spring-beans.xsd
           http://www.springframework.org/schema/context http://www.springframework.org/schema/context/spring-context.xsd">

    <context:annotation-config/>
    <context:component-scan base-package="com.conversational.commerce.occ.controllers"/>

    <bean id="ccUserBindingGuard" class="com.conversational.commerce.occ.security.UserBindingGuard"/>
    <bean id="ccSessionPropagator" class="com.conversational.commerce.occ.security.SessionPropagator"/>

    <!-- Bounded pool: cc.http.pool.size workers, small queue, then reject (the client falls back to POST /chat). -->
    <bean id="ccChatStreamExecutor" class="org.springframework.scheduling.concurrent.ThreadPoolTaskExecutor">
        <property name="corePoolSize" value="${cc.http.pool.size:8}"/>
        <property name="maxPoolSize" value="${cc.http.pool.size:8}"/>
        <property name="queueCapacity" value="16"/>
        <property name="threadNamePrefix" value="cc-stream-"/>
    </bean>
    <bean id="ccChatStreamScheduler" class="org.springframework.scheduling.concurrent.ThreadPoolTaskScheduler">
        <property name="poolSize" value="2"/>
        <property name="threadNamePrefix" value="cc-hb-"/>
    </bean>
</beans>
